identity.title: Hope Creek Generating Station Renewed Facility Operating License No. NPF-57 Docket No. 50-354

cause.proximate_text: the inability of the B EDG to reach max load condition was introduced when fuel rack adjustments were made in April and May, 2021 during planned maintenance conducted during the Hope Creek refuel outage 23. Following the adjustments, the EDG was tested to 4000-4400 kW per TS surveillance requirement 4.8.1.1.2.a, on May 3, 2021. It was not tested at the higher load of 105-110 percent.
cause.theme: inadequate post-maintenance testing following fuel rack adjustment

nodes.display_name: B EDG cylinder injection pump fuel rack mechanical linkage
Fuel rack mechanical linkage improperly adjusted during refuel outage 23 maintenance
nodes.description: Adjustments made to B EDG cylinder injection pumps (fuel rack) during planned maintenance in April/May 2021 left fueling capability degraded.

nodes.display_name: Post-maintenance test did not verify 105-110% load capability
nodes.description: Following the fuel rack adjustment, B EDG was tested only to 4000-4400 kW per TS SR 4.8.1.1.2.a and not tested at the higher 105-110% rated load, so the degraded fueling condition went undetected.

nodes.display_name: B EDG unable to reach required 105-110% rated load
nodes.description: During TS SR 4.8.1.1.2.k surveillance on January 19, 2022, the B EDG could only reach 4650 kW instead of the required 4652-4873 kW during the final 2-hour high-load portion of the test.

nodes.duration: approximately 8.5 months (retroactively determined; exceeds TS 14-day AOT)
